async def act(page):
    # Get all links on the page
    all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
    count = await all_links.count()
    issue_titles = []
    for i in range(count):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        href = await link.get_attribute('href')
        # Filter for links that are issue titles: href contains '/issues/' and does not end with '#notes'
        if href and '/issues/' in href and not href.endswith('#notes'):
            # Further filter to avoid author links or other non-title links by checking if href has a numeric ID
            # Assuming issue URLs are like '/primer/design/-/issues/42'
            if href.split('/')[-1].isdigit():
                title = await link.text_content()
                if title and title.strip():
                    issue_titles.append(title.strip())
    # Print the list of issue titles
    print(issue_titles)
